- more_itertools.numeric_range(args) [class]: An extension of the built-in ``range()`` function whose arguments can be any orderable numeric type.

- more_itertools.partitions(iterable) [function]: Yield all possible order-preserving partitions of *iterable*.

>>> iterable = 'abc'
>>> for part in partitions(iterable):
...     print([''.join(p) for p in part])
['abc']
['a', 'bc']
['ab', 'c']
['a', 'b', 'c']

This is unrelated to :func:`partition`.

- more_itertools.seekable(iterable, maxlen) [class]: Wrap an iterator to allow for seeking backward and forward. This progressively caches the items in the source iterable so they can be re-visited.

- more_itertools.constrained_batches(iterable, max_size, max_count, get_len, strict) [function]: Yield batches of items from *iterable* with a combined size limited by
